name: Release v0.7.2
body:
_These highlights are also published at [flashinfer.ai/releases](https://flashinfer.ai/releases/#v0-7-2)._

### v0.7.2 Highlights

FlashInfer v0.7.2 brings `MoELayer` experts to Rubin through the cuDNN Frost backend, widens Rubin coverage across MLA, GEMM, linear attention and expert-parallel MoE, and adds fused-epilogue Prims-TS GEMMs on B200, B300 and Rubin. On Blackwell datacentre parts, DeepSeek-V4 NVFP4 sparse MLA reaches B200 and B300 and speculative-decode verification picks cuDNN automatically; expert-parallel MoE adds Hopper BF16 and SM120 W4A8 backends.

**`MoELayer` experts run on Rubin**

`MoELayer` on Rubin SM107 can run its experts on cuDNN Frost, a CuTe DSL grouped-GEMM backend for BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4 and MXFP8-activation/MXFP4-weight experts; the BF16 kernels also run on Blackwell SM120. Autotuning admits Frost alongside the existing backends, and `CudnnFrostBf16Config`, `CudnnFrostMxfp8Config`, `CudnnFrostNvfp4Config` and `CudnnFrostMxfp8Mxfp4Config` in `flashinfer.fused_moe` select it explicitly. Frost needs PyTorch 2.14 (`CUDAGraph.retain_object`) and, on SM107, a PTXAS or CuTe DSL assembler from CUDA 13.4 or newer.

- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/6035 Yanqinz/move frost out from experiment
- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5762 Sm120 cudnn frost moe bf16

**DeepSeek-V4 and Kimi K3 serving kernels run on Rubin**

`BatchMLAPagedAttentionWrapper(backend="auto")` plans on B300 and Rubin, and DeepSeek-V4 sparse MLA runs on SM107. Rubin also runs the CuTe DSL GEMM family, `mm_mxfp8(backend="cute-dsl")` on an SM107-specific kernel, the CuTe packed Kimi Delta Attention decode fast path, the CuTe DSL Mamba2 `SSDCombined` prefill, hardware stochastic rounding in the Mamba selective state update, and `silu_and_mul_mxfp8_quantize`. SM107 MegaMoE through `MoEEpLayer` adds MXFP4 weights with MXFP8 activations, prequantized NVFP4 and MXFP8 checkpoints, and Kimi K3's SiTU activation, functionally validated on Rubin.

**GEMMs fuse SwiGLU and QKV-norm-RoPE epilogues on B200, B300 and Rubin**

`flashinfer.prims_ts` adds dense FP8 and NVFP4 GEMMs with fused SwiGLU (`fp8_linear_swiglu`, `fp4_linear_swiglu`) and fused QKV + QK-norm + RoPE (`fp8_qkv_qknorm_rope`, `fp4_qkv_qknorm_rope`) epilogues on B200, B300 and Rubin SM107. The NVFP4 SwiGLU and QKV variants accept an opt-in `tmem_overlap=True` tactic, which the autotuner also considers. The module needs the CuTe DSL experimental primitives shipped with `nvidia-cutlass-dsl`.

**DeepSeek-V4 NVFP4 sparse MLA reaches B200 and B300 and adds prefill on RTX PRO 6000**

DeepSeek-V4 serving with an NVFP4 KV cache runs sparse-MLA decode on B200 and B300 through `trtllm_batch_decode_sparse_mla_dsv4(kv_cache_format="nvfp4", backend="cake")`. On RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell and RTX 5090 the same entry point gains a `backend="cake"` decode and prefill path for the NVFP4 cache and a decode path for the DeepSeek-V4.1 mixed FP8/FP4 cache (SM120 and GB10/SM121), plus fused RoPE, NVFP4 quantize and paged-insert cache writers. These backends are opt-in.

**Speculative-decode verification runs faster on B200 and B300**

`BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper(backend="auto")` on B200 and B300 routes multi-token decode rows (two to four query tokens per request, as in speculative or multi-token-prediction verification) of fp16/bf16 head-dim-128 grouped-query-attention models to cuDNN, which lowers verification decode latency. The route needs `nvidia-cudnn-frontend[cutedsl]>=1.31.0`. Single-token decode and runs with explicit determinism controls stay on FA2; `FLASHINFER_DECODE_AUTO_CUDNN=0` pins FA2.

- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5508 feat(cudnn): backend="auto" takes cuDNN for the multi-token paged-decode rows its default FROST engine serves faster (cudnn-frontend 1.30+)

**Expert-parallel MoE comes to H100 in BF16 and to SM120 in W4A8**

H100 serves an expert-parallel MoE round entirely in BF16 through `MoEEpLayer` with `Sm90_Bf16_Bf16_Bf16_PushCake_MegaMoeConfig`: BF16 dispatch, fused SwiGLU, a deterministic combine over a pre-reduced BF16 wire, CUDA Graph capture and up to 32 ranks on one node. SM120 workstations get a W4A8 MegaMoE backend (`Sm120_Mxfp4_Mxfp8_Bf16_Cutedsl_MegaMoeConfig`) with CUDA Graph replay and uneven token counts across ranks. `SplitConfig(comm=..., kernel=...)` picks an NVLink one-sided, CAKE or NVLink two-sided communication backend, or the NCCL-EP or NIXL-EP transports, independently of the expert kernel.

> **⚠️ Upgrade notices**
>
> - Install `nvidia-cudnn-frontend>=1.31.0`. The cuDNN linear-attention backend and the automatic cuDNN decode route need the `cutedsl` extra: `pip install -U 'nvidia-cudnn-frontend[cutedsl]>=1.31.0'`.
> - After upgrading `flashinfer-python`, run `flashinfer download-kernels` to replace mismatched `flashinfer-cubin` and `flashinfer-jit-cache` wheels; `--sm sm90a` (repeatable) limits it to named architectures.
> - Rename callers of `cutlass_fused_moe_prepare_workspace` to `cake_fused_moe_prepare_workspace`, replace `prepare_bgmv_moe(..., backend="blackwell")` with `backend="cake"`, and import the cuDNN Frost MoE configs from `flashinfer.fused_moe` (the `flashinfer.experimental` path is a one-release shim).
> - Sampling: batch-length `seed` and `offset` tensors apply one value per output row; callers passing distinct per-row values sample differently from before.

> **⚠️ Upgrade notices (Experimental)**
>
> - `flashinfer.source_mega_moe` (`MegaMoEPlan`, `prepare_mega_moe`) is removed; use `flashinfer.mega_moe_v3`.
> - `prepare_msa_nvfp4_sparse_decode` drops `workspace_buffer`; `msa_nvfp4_decode_workspace_size`, `workspace_layout` and `bind_decode_payload` are removed. DeepGEMM-family `prepare_*` entry points drop their descriptor arguments.

body:
_These highlights are also published at [flashinfer.ai/releases](https://flashinfer.ai/releases/#v0-7-1)._

### v0.7.1 Highlights

FlashInfer v0.7.1 enables quantized expert-parallel MoE on Rubin and Blackwell SM12x, adds fused Kimi K3 speculative verification, and adds cuDNN linear-attention prefill on Blackwell. Sparse MLA gains DeepSeek-V4.1 dual-cache support and compact GLM53-NoPE caches, alongside MLA API improvements and per-model NVFP4 quantization recipes.

**Run quantized expert-parallel MoE on Rubin and Blackwell SM12x**

Rubin SM107 serves NVFP4 and MXFP8 MegaMoE experts through `MoEEpLayer`, with BF16 combine and output. On Blackwell SM120/SM121, the W4A16 fused MoE shards experts across GPUs through `expert_map`, so multi-GPU workstations such as RTX PRO 6000 pairs can split a model's experts between cards. New CuTe DSL NVFP4 W4A16 and W4A4 MoE backends on SM12x read one prepared expert layout, so a serving stack can choose W4A16 for decode and W4A4 for prefill from a single weight copy; on DGX Spark the W4A16 backend runs a Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MoE layer 1.36× faster than Marlin at one token. The split MoE layer also supports CUDA Graph capture with both NCCL-EP and NIXL-EP.

- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5384 feat(moe_ep): add SM107 block-scaled MegaMoE backends
- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/4302 feat(moe): expert parallelism for the SM12x W4A16 fused MoE
- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5735 Canonical-layout NVFP4 W4A16 MoE in CuTe DSL on SM12x
- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5863 Canonical-layout NVFP4 W4A4 MoE in CuTe DSL on SM12x
- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5287 feat(moe_ep): CUDA-graph support for the split layer (nccl_ep + nixl_ep)

**Kimi K3 adds packed speculative decoding and NVFP4 SiTU experts**

Kimi K3 integrations can use `packed_fused_kda_decode` on Blackwell SM10x to fuse short convolution, Kimi Delta Attention, and gated RMS normalization during speculative verification. In vLLM on eight B300s with six-draft-token speculative decoding, the fused path raised total output throughput by 1.8–3.3% at concurrencies 1 to 32. The API supports ragged batches, accepted-token cache updates, CUDA Graph capture, and FP32 or BF16 recurrent state. NVFP4 MegaMoE also supports Kimi K3's SiTU activation on Blackwell SM10x.

- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/4809 feat(kda): add fused speculative decode kernel
- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5503 feat(kda): support bf16 state in packed fused KDA decode for T>1
- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5455 feat(moe_ep): Support Kimi K3 SiTU in NVFP4 MegaMoE

**Kimi Delta Attention and Gated DeltaNet prefill on Blackwell are supported with cuDNN's open-source kernels**

Kimi Delta Attention and Gated DeltaNet prefill run on cuDNN's open-source fused linear-attention engine on Blackwell SM100, selected with `recurrent_kda(backend="cudnn")` and `chunk_gated_delta_rule(backend="cudnn")`. The cuDNN path also runs on CUDA 12 builds, where the default Blackwell Gated DeltaNet prefill kernel requires CUDA 13. New `chunk_gated_delta_product` and `chunk_gated_delta_rule2` entry points add Gated Delta Product and Gated Delta Rule 2 prefill on the same engine.

- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/4968 Add cuDNN backend for linear attention

**Run DeepSeek-V4.1 dual-cache attention on SM12x with 19.5% smaller GLM53-NoPE caches**

DeepSeek-V4.1 sparse MLA runs on SM120/SM121 with a primary FP8 cache and an optional FP4 or FP8 extra cache, each with its own page size and top-k selection, in FP8 or BF16 compute. GLM53-NoPE caches can use compact 528-byte rows, cutting per-token KV storage by 19.5% against the 656-byte padded layout; existing 656-byte pools keep working through strided cache views.

- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5197 refactor(sparse-mla): unify SM120 execution, calibration and DSv4.1 support
- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5075 feat(sm120): runtime KV row stride + canonical 528B GLM53_NOPE rows + NaN-safe masked gathers in sparse MLA

**Call MLA prefill directly and reuse execution plans**

`trtllm_prefill_with_kv_cache_mla`, available through both `flashinfer.mla` and `flashinfer.prefill`, gives integrations a named prefill entry point with the existing MLA decode API's signature and behavior. Multi-token prefill callers must explicitly select a compatible backend; XQA supports one query token. `BatchMLAPagedAttentionWrapper` prepares TRTLLM-GEN, XQA, and monolithic or modular CuTe DSL backends in `plan()` and reuses them in `run()`, giving integrations a shared lifecycle for repeated execution and CUDA Graph capture. On SM100, callers can pass `backend="auto"` and let `plan()` choose among all available backends for the planned shapes and features.

- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5158 fix: add discoverable MLA prefill API
- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5070 feat(mla): add planned TRTLLM-GEN, XQA, and CuTe DSL backends
- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5463 feat(mla): MLA SM100 auto mode

**NVFP4 recipes can be configured per model**

NVFP4 quantization APIs and the unified MoE `QuantConfig` accept an explicit `NVFP44Over6Config`, so a serving framework can enable 4over6 from a model's own quantization config and run models with different recipes in one process. The process-wide environment variables remain the default when no recipe is given.

- https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/5152 feat(quantization): expose NVFP4 4over6 recipe through the public API

**Upgrade notices**

- Install `nvidia-cudnn-frontend>=1.30.0`. The cuDNN linear-attention backend needs the `cutedsl` extra: `pip install -U 'nvidia-cudnn-frontend[cutedsl]>=1.30.0'`.
- SM90 CuTe DSL MoE: `cute_dsl_fused_moe_bf16` takes `tactic` for tuning, and `CuteDslBf16MoEWrapper` reorders its constructor arguments. Pass `output_dtype`, `enable_pdl`, and `use_fused_finalize` by keyword. `moe_a2a_dispatch` takes `recv_view_cache` by keyword only.

**Upgrade notices (Experimental)**

- Update calls to `fp8_paged_mqa_logits` and `fp4_paged_mqa_logits`: use `block_tables`, `seq_lens`, and `max_seq_len`; pass the page table before sequence lengths in positional calls; remove `num_epi_subtiles`. FP4 callers must also rename `sf_q` to `q_sf`.
- Review PrimTS integrations against the experimental API contract. Migrate callers of the removed `prims_ts_batch_decode_with_kv_cache` and `prims_ts_batch_mla_decode_with_kv_cache` entry points to the corresponding paged decode wrappers.
